info.title: PAK Portal MVP read-only API
info.description: P8C-R1 design contract; runtime not deployed. All resources are sanitized DTOs. No arbitrary paths, label selectors, URLs or mutations. Unknown query keys return 400. Missing required source => unavailable/partial, never invented zero. Backup aggregates capped at 500 per source; partial flag required if truncated. Other collection pages <=200. Namespace filter excludes cluster-scoped rows when explicitly provided.
